articles.title: Earth as a Giant Dark Matter Detector? New Signals Spark Hope
articles.summary: Using Earth's magnetic field, scientists found mysterious signals that could be dark matter. The new limits are 100 times tighter than before. But they're not confirmed yet.

articles.title: Listening to Wildfires: Low-Frequency Rumbles Could Revolutionize Fire Tracking
articles.summary: Researchers used infrasound sensors to track a wildfire in Idaho, even when it was barely burning. This could help detect fires early, but wind might be a problem.

articles.title: SpaceX Hits 103 Falcon 9 Launches in 2026 with Another Starlink Mission
articles.summary: SpaceX launched 27 Starlink satellites today, marking the 103rd Falcon 9 mission of 2026. The booster landed on a drone ship for its 19th flight.
